feeds.title: Mil Besos Weddings Blog

feeds.title: Raw Shoots Blog

With over 5 years of experience, we have documented many weddings and elopements in some of the most gorgeous corners of Costa Rica. Check out some of our recent works in the blog.

Know more about destination weddings in Costa Rica, my portfolio, photography tips and more!

feeds.title: Kuba Okon Weddings
feeds.description: In this wedding journal and blog you will find wedding tips, advice, and ideas I have gathered in my experience as a destination wedding photographer, and that I am more than happy to share with couples who are planning their next step. I'm Kuba Okon. I'm a Polish wedding photographer based in Costa Rica. I specialize in destination weddings in Central America, but I'm available to travel worldwide. My style comes from experience as an award-winning painter

feeds.title: Kevin Heslin Photography Blog
feeds.description: Here you can find the behind the scene stories of my most recent weddings, as well as travel and cultural projects throughout Costa Rica. I am Kevin. I have been photographing destination weddings in Costa Rica for 15 years now. I shoot everything from intimate elopements to huge beach wedding bashes.
